name: Shaker Furniture of Maine
old_description: Explore two floors and nearly 10,000 square feet of bedrooms, living rooms, dining tables and chairs, and accent pieces crafted from native hardwoods such as cherry, maple, and oak. We stock plenty of classic pine furniture too, carefully prefinished or ready for paint/stain. Every single piece is solid wood, and made with pride in American shops.
about:
Shaker Furniture of Maine operates from a two-floor, nearly 10,000-square-foot showroom on Route 1 in Scarborough, Maine. The business is owned by proprietor Steve Celona, who emphasizes that every piece is solid wood and made with pride in American shops.

The company manufactures and sells solid-wood furniture including bedroom sets, living-room pieces, dining tables and chairs, and accent items. Materials are native hardwoods such as cherry, maple, and oak, along with classic pine offered prefinished or ready for paint or stain. The facility supports custom builds to customer specifications, and the company ships nationwide.

Shaker Furniture serves primarily residential customers through its showroom and direct shipping, offering expert personal service and value-driven pricing. While the company does not list specific industrial sectors, its custom-build capability suggests it can accommodate interior designers and hospitality projects.

The brand differentiates itself with a “Proudly Made in Maine and Made in America” commitment, highlighting domestic production, timeless Shaker-inspired designs, and a hands-on shopping experience across two floors of inventory.
